'''2026 U.S. Retro Nationals''' was the retro event at the [[2026 U.S. National Championship]], played on 1 August 2026. [[Andy Talaga]] said the venue was The Heldrich in New Brunswick.<ref name="dc-site" /> He named the players on site as himself, Worm Time, [[Steve Sanders]], [[Matt Manning]], [[Jonny Chu]], [[Apollo Chu]], [[Matt Sokol]], and [[Joe Gianetti]], and said the field meant four rounds.<ref name="dc-players" /><ref name="dc-rounds" /> [[Jonny Chu]] won.<ref name="dc-winner" />

== Format ==

* '''Formats named:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II|Death Star II]] and [[Cube|cube]]<ref name="dc-format" />
* '''Site:''' The Heldrich in New Brunswick<ref name="dc-site" />
* '''Date:''' 1 August 2026<ref name="dc-rounds" />
* '''Rounds:''' 4<ref name="dc-rounds" />

== Results ==

! Finish !! Player
|-
| 1 || [[Jonny Chu]]<ref name="dc-winner" />

[[Andy Talaga]] called round 2 Worm Time versus [[Matt Sokol]], and round 3 [[Jonny Chu]] versus [[Matt Sokol]].<ref name="dc-r2" /><ref name="dc-r3" />
